label: Every word on the Rule Chip Builder (Rules) screen

params.name: lede
params.default: When a trigger fires, given the facts it carries, if the rule's test holds, then its outcomes happen — a banner, an email, a refusal, a value or a flag. Every number and word is a knob you can change here. Drafts run only on scenarios and never send anything.

params.name: find_placeholder
params.default: Find a rule — id, label or trigger

params.name: leave_body
params.default: Your changes to {id} are not saved. If you go on, they are lost.

params.name: empty_body
params.default: A rule says what the portal does when something happens: warn the owner, refuse a sign-up, flag a visit.

params.name: not_saved_meta
params.default: Not saved yet. Save draft keeps it; until it is published it runs only here, on scenarios.

params.name: switched_off_note
params.default: Switched off — it does not fire until it is switched on.

params.name: label_placeholder
params.default: What the rule does, in one sentence

params.name: desc_placeholder
params.default: Why it exists, and when to switch it off — for the next person who reads it.

params.name: no_facts
params.default: This trigger hands over no facts.

params.name: pick_trigger_facts
params.default: Pick a trigger to see the facts a rule can read.

params.name: read_fact_hint
params.default: Read a fact in a test as Knob / fact, or inside outcome words as {name}.

params.name: change_trigger_body
params.default: “{trigger}” cannot do: {kinds}. Those outcomes stay, and the check flags them until you change their kind or remove them.

params.name: knobs_title
params.default: numbers and words you can change without touching the logic

params.name: knobs_sub
params.default: Read a knob in a test as Knob / fact, in outcome words as {name}, or press “use a knob” on an outcome field.

params.name: knobs_hint
params.default: Each knob has a name, a type and a default. Change the default here and the rule follows — no logic to touch.

params.name: name_rule
params.default: A name is letters, digits and _.

params.name: value_exists
params.default: There is already a value named {name}.

params.name: name_taken
params.default: {name} is already a fact or a knob — pick another name.

params.name: values_sub
params.default: Optional. In order, before the test: each one can read the facts, the knobs and the values above it — as $name in a test, or {name} in outcome words.

params.name: no_values
params.default: No named values. Add one when the test or a message needs a number worked out first.

params.name: scen_hint_of
params.default: Saved facts of {subject}. Scenarios about something else are greyed out.

params.name: if_sub
params.default: A test is true, false or unknown. Unknown — a fact it needs is missing — never fires the rule.

params.name: then_sub
params.default: In this order, every time the rule fires.

params.name: then_hint
params.default: Words fill in when it fires: {fact}, {knob} and {value.field} are replaced by their values — e.g. {rss_mb}. A field can also take its value straight from a knob: press “use a knob”.

params.name: no_outcome
params.default: No outcome yet. A rule that does nothing cannot be published.

params.name: pick_trigger_outcomes
params.default: Pick a trigger first — it decides which outcomes can happen.

params.name: priority_hint
params.default: Higher runs first when several rules share this trigger.

params.name: stop_label
params.default: Stop other rules when this fires

params.name: stop_hint
params.default: Lower-priority rules on this trigger are skipped once this one has outcomes.

params.name: kind_not_here
params.default: A {kind} outcome cannot happen at “{trigger}”. Change its kind or remove it.

params.name: not_field
params.default: not a field of this kind

params.name: dry_sub
params.default: Whether the rule fires on a scenario, and exactly what each outcome would say.

params.name: dry_stale
params.default: The rule, scenario or facts changed since this run — press Run again.

params.name: dry_idle
params.default: Pick a scenario and press Run. Nothing is sent.

params.name: unknown
params.default: Unknown — a fact or value it needs is missing, so it does not fire.

params.name: preview_note
params.default: {where} Nothing was sent — this is a preview.

params.name: fires_no_outcome
params.default: It fires, but has no outcome.

params.name: no_mail_banner
params.default: without mail set up it becomes a banner

params.name: refuse_sub
params.default: the action is stopped and the person is told

params.name: tests_sub
params.default: Say at least one scenario where it fires and one where it does not. A publish is refused while a test fails.

params.name: check_sub
params.default: Problems and every test, run again a moment after each edit.

params.name: history_sub
params.default: An old version comes back as a draft, checked again before it can go live.

params.name: other_sub
params.default: Fields this screen has no dedicated place for. They are kept, shown and saved with the rule.

params.name: restored
params.default: Version {v} is back as a draft. Check it, then publish.

params.name: restore_title
params.default: Restore this version as a draft?

params.name: restore_lose
params.default: It replaces the current draft and any unsaved changes.

params.name: restore_body
params.default: The live rule does not change until the draft is published.

params.name: ro_stops
params.default: stops other rules when it fires

params.name: draft_saved
params.default: Draft saved. It runs only here, on scenarios, until it is published.

params.name: submitted
params.default: Sent for review. An editor can publish it, or return it with a note.

params.name: published
params.default: Published. It acts from the next time its trigger fires.

params.name: not_published
params.default: Not published: fix the problems and failing tests first.

params.name: return_body
params.default: The draft goes back to {who} as a draft, with your note on top.

params.name: return_dropped
params.default: Your unsaved edits to it are dropped.

params.name: note_placeholder
params.default: e.g. The cooldown is too short — the owner would get an email every minute.

params.name: returned
params.default: Returned to the author with your note.

params.name: discard_body_dirty
params.default: The draft and your unsaved changes are thrown away.

params.name: discard_live
params.default: The live rule stays exactly as it is.

params.name: discard_never
params.default: This rule was never published, so it leaves the list.

params.name: off_body
params.default: It stops firing straight away. Nothing is deleted — switch it on again any time.

params.name: switched_on
params.default: Switched on. It fires from the next time its trigger does.

params.name: delete_body
params.default: {id} stops firing and its live file is removed.

params.name: delete_draft_stays
params.default: Its draft stays, so it can be published again.

params.name: delete_history
params.default: A copy stays in its history on the server.

params.name: cancel_new_body
params.default: It was never saved, so nothing else changes.

params.name: copy_intro
params.default: Everything in {id} — including edits not saved yet — goes into the copy. The original stays as it is saved.

params.name: id_hint
params.default: Lower-case letters, digits and _ ; starts with a letter; 3–60 long. It cannot change later.

params.name: new_label_placeholder
params.default: What it does, in one sentence

params.name: no_triggers
params.default: No trigger is registered on this portal yet.

params.name: id_bad
params.default: Lower-case letters, digits and _ only; start with a letter; 3–60 long.

params.name: id_taken
params.default: A rule with this id already exists.

params.name: id_good
params.default: Good. The id cannot change later.

params.name: need_label
params.default: Give the rule a label — one sentence saying what it does.

params.name: move_edge
params.default: It is already at that end of the list.
params.label: move_edge

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.rcb.<lang> (for example ui.rcb.hi).
